# BeOp

## Example

```html
<amp-ad
  width="300"
  height="1"
  type="beop"
  data-account="5be04b9546e0fb00011f9fa7"
  data-name="bellow-article"
  layout="responsive"
>
</amp-ad>
```

## Configuration

We have a [documentation page](https://docs.beop.io/amp-sdk) that helps to configure amp tags

Supported parameters:

- `data-account` → your account id as a publisher on BeOp Platform
- `data-name` → the name you want to give to your slot
